production.format_and_medium.summary: A public agency shall provide an electronic copy or a paper copy of a public record at the option of the person making the request.

production.delivery_and_completion.summary: After a proper request, the agency must produce copies or permit copying within a reasonable time.

production.inspection_access.summary: A public agency may (but need not) permit a person to inspect and copy records through enhanced access under a contract described in section 3.5.

production.no_duty_to_create_or_convert.summary: An agency is not required to reprogram a computer system to provide enhanced access or access to a governmental entity by an electronic device.

eligibility.any_person.summary: Any person may inspect and copy the public records of any public agency during the agency's regular business hours.

eligibility.no_purpose_requirement.summary: A public agency may not deny a request because the requester refuses to state the purpose of the request, unless another applicable statute requires it.

eligibility.no_residency_requirement.summary: The right to inspect and copy public records extends to any person; the Act imposes no residency or citizenship qualification.

classification.commercial_purpose.summary: 'Commercial purpose' is defined by statute and, where it applies, drives fee treatment and the list-disclosure restriction.

Clarification.deny.label: Deny as vague / overbroad

intake.reasonably_describes.summary: A request must identify with reasonable particularity the record being requested for the agency's duty to attach.

Clarification.deny.note: Deny-as-vague is narrower than reasonably-describes membership: TN·NJ·OH, OK only after SB 535 engagement (diagram legend, v2.2).

Estimate-Fee.proc.label: No → proceed to work; collect at end
Estimate-Fee.proc.note: Collect-at-end is the default path wherever production is NOT statutorily conditioned on prepayment.

Records-Search.prog.label: BUT extraction/programming of EXISTING

production.no_duty_to_create_or_convert.summary: An agency is not required to reprogram a computer system to provide enhanced access or access to a governmental entity by an electronic device.

Records-Search.prog.note: Programming-≠-creation loop is TX 552.231 only; the broader no-duty-to-create concept (16 states) is context, not an activator.

special_records.special_production_const.summary: Enumerated lists (e.g., of names and addresses) may not be disclosed to any individual/entity for political purposes, nor to commercial entities for commercial purposes.

Disposition.caps.label: REQUESTOR-LEDGER CHECK (class D)
Disposition.caps.note: Requestor-ledger class-D delivery caps (OH) ride on ledger config; see ledger section.

acknowledgment.note: No statutory timer — city operational target only (soft-standard pattern S-002).

denial.deemed_denial_on_nonresponse.summary: For a request made in person, by telephone, or for enhanced access, a denial is deemed to occur when 24 hours elapse after an agency employee refuses to permit inspection and copying.
denial.deemed_denial_on_nonresponse.clock_spec: terminal: denial deemed at 24 hours after an agency employee's refusal to permit inspection/copying (in-person, telephone, or enhanced-access requests)

denial.deemed_denial_on_nonresponse.summary: For a request received by mail or facsimile, a denial of disclosure does not occur until seven days elapse from the date the agency receives the request.
denial.deemed_denial_on_nonresponse.clock_spec: terminal: denial deemed 7 days from the date the public agency receives a mailed or faxed request

denial.deemed_denial_on_nonresponse.summary: Agency silence/refusal for the applicable statutory window is deemed a denial of disclosure, moving the request into a denied state.
denial.deemed_denial_on_nonresponse.clock_spec: terminal: request enters denied state upon expiry of the applicable § 5-14-3-9 window

fee.copy_rate_per_page.summary: The fee for copying documents may not exceed the greater of ten cents ($0.10) per non-color page or twenty-five cents ($0.25) per color page, or the agency's actual cost.

fee.electronic_media_charge.summary: An agency may charge the requester the agency's direct cost of reprogramming a computer system where reprogramming is required to separate disclosable from nondisclosable information stored electronically.
An agency may charge a fee for providing an electronic map based upon a reasonable percentage of the agency's direct cost of maintaining, upgrading, and enhancing the electronic map.

fee.certified_copy_charge.summary: The fee for certification of documents may not exceed five dollars ($5) per document.

fee.special_service_charge.summary: An agency may charge any reasonable fee agreed on in an enhanced-access contract under section 3.5 for providing enhanced access to public records.

fee.schedule_and_authority.summary: For a local public agency, the fiscal body of the political subdivision establishes the copying fee schedule by ordinance, and the fee must be uniform.
For a local public agency, the fiscal body of the political subdivision establishes the copying fee schedule by ordinance, and the fee must be uniform.
